title: Baked Irish Sausage with Quick Irish Fix
description: A fusion of Irish flavors with Chinese technique, this dish combines the classic Irish sausage with a sweet and savory baked sauce.

ingredients.name: Quick fix sauce (soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar)

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the Irish sausage on the baking sheet.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Quick fix sauce and baked bake until smooth.
Brush the sauce mixture evenly over the sausage.
Bake the sausage for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the sausage is baking, heat the sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger to the wok and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the green onions and snow peas to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the baked sausage with the stir-fried vegetables and sauce.
